_note: Single source of truth for events. Names, images and slugs are the real data already present in this repo (originally hardcoded in views/carousal_events.ejs). `category` is an editorial grouping of that real data. Everything genuinely unknown is null and MUST stay null until confirmed — the UI renders around nulls rather than inventing dates, venues, prizes or rules. `registration` is 'open' because /register is live and writes to the same useraccounts store as the existing payment_gateway project. Change per-event as entries close. ADDED from the ENGINEER '26 sponsorship brochure: the `_tracks` block and every event's `track`; the Startup Pitch, ENGI Care (Music For All / Techadapt / Innovate4Good), Auto Expo and Stunt Show events. Descriptions are quoted from that brochure where it supplies them — the brochure describes TRACKS, not individual events, so the remaining 15 descriptions were written here at the organising team’s request. They describe the FORMAT of each event and nothing else — no weight class, duration, team size, prize, venue or time appears in any of them, because those are organiser decisions and stay null in their own fields until confirmed. Event heads should still replace them with their own copy; overwrite the string and nothing else changes.

events.name: Robowars
events.description: Machine against machine. Teams build armoured, remote-controlled combat robots and send them into the arena until only one of them is still moving.

events.name: The Engineer Hackathon
events.description: A build sprint against the clock. Teams take a problem brief and have until the deadline to turn it into something that actually runs — judged on the working demo, not the pitch deck.

events.name: Robocon Bot Expo
events.description: The machines built for Robocon, up close. Teams bring the bots they have spent a season on, run them, and explain the engineering to anyone who asks.

events.name: Engi Talks
events.description: Fostering collaboration and engineering excellence, a wide range of experts from fields such as art, administration, politics and defence deliver compelling talks on current issues, engaging in active discussion with the audience.

events.name: Workshops
events.description: Hands-on sessions run by people who do the work for a living. You build something over the course of the session and leave knowing how to do it again on your own.

events.name: Line Tracker Bot Race
events.description: No driver. Teams build an autonomous bot that reads a line off the floor and follows it through the circuit — the cleanest, fastest run takes it.

events.name: Robo Soccer
events.description: Football, played by remote-controlled bots. Two sides, one ball, a walled pitch, and machines built to push, block and score.

events.name: Wright Flight
events.description: Aeromodelling, from the bench to the air. Bring the aircraft you built and fly it — control, endurance and handling all count once it leaves your hands.

events.name: FPV Drone Racing
events.description: A high-energy FPV drone racing competition. Custom-built racing drones run a purpose-built obstacle course, and pilots are judged on speed, precision, reflexes and technical skill.
rules: Three rounds: technical inspection, timed qualifiers, then a 4v4 showdown.
Drones must be custom-built FPV quadcopters.
The course runs through 4 standard gates and 8 slalom posts.

events.name: Robo Racing
events.description: Bots against a track. Custom-built machines run a timed course with obstacles in the way, so traction, steering and nerve all get tested at once.

events.name: Open House Labs
events.description: NITK's research labs open their doors. Walk into the centres where the work actually happens and have the people doing it show you what they are building.

events.name: Tech Space Quizzers
events.description: A quiz for people who read the footnotes. Science, space and technology, from the well-known to the genuinely obscure.

events.name: Beach Event
events.description: NITK has its own stretch of coast, and ENGINEER uses it. Sand, saltwater and the fest carried down to the shoreline.

events.name: Tech Mela
events.description: The fest spread across campus as a fair — stalls, demonstrations and builds you can walk up to, handle and ask about.

events.name: Startup Pitch
events.description: Our startup pitch sessions are the heartbeat of entrepreneurial creativity, where bright minds converge to showcase disruptive ideas — an opportunity to foster innovation, connect with visionary thinkers and shape the future of industries.

events.name: Music For All
events.description: A musical performance by specially-abled kids, staged as part of ENGI Care.

events.name: Techadapt
events.description: Games designed for and played with specially-abled participants.

events.name: Innovate4Good
events.description: A national case study contest on building technology that does social good.

events.name: Auto Expo
events.description: Machines on display, engines included. A showcase of vehicles brought onto campus for the run of the fest.

events.name: Stunt Show
events.description: Professional riders taking physics to the edge of what it will allow, performed live on campus.

events.name: VR: Step Into Space
events.description: Step into an immersive virtual world built around the wonders of space. Participants wear a VR headset and play a specially selected space-themed game, putting them at the centre of the virtual adventure.
events.eligibility: Open to students of all years

events.name: Telescope Making Workshop
events.description: Build a small reflective telescope you can actually observe the night sky with, and take it home. All materials and guidance are provided — lenses, adhesives, pipes and mirrors, with the AAC team walking you through it.
events.teamSize: Limited to 40 participants (first come, first served)

events.name: Planetarium
events.description: A portable planetarium built in-house by AAC NITK from aluminium frames and cardboard. Sit inside the dome for a five-minute film the club made itself, travelling from our solar system out to distant galaxies.

events.name: Projects Expo
events.description: Student-led projects in space, astronomy and exploration, shown by the people who built them. Featured systems include a modular radio telescope and an exoplanet terrain mapping system that renders terrain in 3D.

events.name: AstroQuiz
events.description: A space-themed quiz spanning the solar system, stars, galaxies, space missions and the latest discoveries in astronomy and space science. Casual stargazers and serious enthusiasts both welcome.

events.name: Verilog Quest
events.description: A hardware hackathon framed as a rescue: each team is the tech support behind a hero, writing Verilog to out-think the enemy. Round one is simulation, round two puts the same ideas onto real FPGA boards.

timeline.what: Simulation — Verilog problems against enemy algorithms, verified with custom testbenches
Hardware challenge — FPGA programming and verification on Altera Cyclone boards

events.name: recHERSion
events.description: A 24-hour hackathon built exclusively for women, run online and offline. Teams pick from a curated set of real-world problem statements and build a complete solution in 24 hours, backed by mentorship from industry experts.
events.venue: Online, and offline at CCC NITK

timeline.what: Ideate, build and present within 24 hours

events.name: SIM2REAL
events.description: A robotics event about closing the gap between simulation and the real world. Hands-on challenges across autonomous systems, drones and swarm robotics ask participants to turn a working simulation into something that survives real deployment.

technical.name: Technical Events
technical.blurb: Bright minds from across the country compete, collaborate and innovate — coding challenges, robotics, workshops and technology-driven competitions.

startup.name: Startup Pitch
startup.blurb: The heartbeat of entrepreneurial creativity, where bright minds converge to showcase disruptive ideas and shape the future of industries.

talks.name: Engi Talks
talks.blurb: Experts from art, administration, politics and defence deliver compelling talks on current issues, in active discussion with the audience.

care.name: ENGI Care
care.blurb: Our CSR initiative — a testament to making a positive difference in the lives of those around us.

campus.name: Campus & Expo
campus.blurb: The parts of ENGINEER that spill out of the lecture halls and onto the campus itself.
